title: 1 Monthly Career Habit You NEED to Be Doing ✍️
description:
This career habit is a GAME CHANGER. Updating your resume is rarely a good time and it’s make even less enjoyable if you’re trying to remember things that happened at work 6 months ago. If you take 30 minutes every month, or even 5 minutes every week, and write down your work wins it’s going to make updating your resume much easier. Not to mention a good amount of the work already done for your resume. #careeradvice #career #careermode
